description:
crate-jmap-chat-server/README.md 'Usage' example says `Dispatcher<()>` and the 'CallerCtx' section says 'register_chat_handlers takes CallerCtx = ()'. Actual signature is generic:

```rust
pub fn register_chat_handlers<B, C>(...)
where C: Clone + Send + 'static,
```

The README is more restrictive than the API. Fix the example to use a generic placeholder, e.g. `Dispatcher<MyCallerCtx>` with a comment explaining MyCallerCtx is your application's per-request context type.
title: P3: chat-server README claims Dispatcher<()>, but register_chat_handlers is generic over CallerCtx
